```{r setup}
library(econkit)
library(ggplot2)

horizon <- as.integer(params$horizon)
start <- as.Date(params$start)
raw <- ek_get_series(source = params$source)

d <- raw
d$ip_yoy <- ek_transform(d$INDPRO, "yoy")
d$cpi_yoy <- ek_transform(d$CPIAUCSL, "yoy")
d$core_yoy <- ek_transform(d$PCEPILFE, "yoy")
d$payrolls_3m <- ek_transform(d$PAYEMS, "diff", n = 3) / 3
d$sahm <- ek_sahm_rule(d$UNRATE)
d$regime <- ek_growth_inflation_regime(d$ip_yoy, d$cpi_yoy)

model <- ek_recession_model(d, horizon = horizon)
pred <- predict(model, newdata = d)
bt <- ek_backtest_recession(d, horizon = horizon, label_lag = 6)

ip <- d$INDPRO[!is.na(d$INDPRO)]
gap <- ek_output_gap(ip)
d$output_gap <- NA_real_
d$output_gap[!is.na(d$INDPRO)] <- gap$cycle

growth <- ek_transform(ip, "log_diff")[-1]
msm <- ek_markov_switching(growth)
d$p_contraction <- NA_real_
d$p_contraction[which(!is.na(d$INDPRO))[-1]] <- msm$filtered[, 1]
current <- lapply(d, function(v) v[max(c(1L, which(!is.na(v))))])

plot_data <- d[d$date >= start, ]
rec_spans <- local({
  r <- plot_data$USREC
  r[is.na(r)] <- 0
  starts <- plot_data$date[which(diff(c(0, r)) == 1)]
  ends <- plot_data$date[which(diff(c(r, 0)) == -1)]
  data.frame(start = starts, end = ends)
})
shade <- function() {
  geom_rect(data = rec_spans, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.6)
}
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
```

## Summary as of `r format(max(d$date), "%B %Y")`

Latest available value of each indicator.

```{r summary}
latest_prob <- tail(pred$probability[!is.na(pred$probability)], 1)
tbl <- data.frame(
  Indicator = c(
    sprintf("Recession probability (%d months ahead)", horizon),
    "10Y-3M term spread (pp)", "Sahm rule indicator (pp)", "Unemployment rate (%)",
    "Payrolls, 3-month average change (k)", "Industrial production YoY (%)",
    "CPI inflation YoY (%)", "Core PCE inflation YoY (%)", "Output gap (IP, % of trend)",
    "Financial conditions (NFCI)", "Growth/inflation regime",
    "Markov contraction probability (filtered)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * latest_prob), sprintf("%.2f", current$T10Y3M),
    sprintf("%.2f", current$sahm), sprintf("%.1f", current$UNRATE),
    sprintf("%.0f", current$payrolls_3m), sprintf("%.1f", current$ip_yoy),
    sprintf("%.1f", current$cpi_yoy), sprintf("%.1f", current$core_yoy),
    sprintf("%.1f", current$output_gap), sprintf("%.2f", current$NFCI),
    as.character(current$regime), sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * current$p_contraction)
  ),
  Signal = c(
    ifelse(latest_prob > 0.3, "Elevated", "Low"),
    ifelse(current$T10Y3M < 0, "Inverted", "Positive"),
    ifelse(current$sahm >= 0.5, "Triggered", "Not triggered"),
    "", "", "", "", "",
    ifelse(current$output_gap > 0, "Above trend", "Below trend"),
    ifelse(current$NFCI > 0, "Tighter than average", "Looser than average"),
    "", ifelse(current$p_contraction > 0.5, "Contraction", "Expansion")
  )
)
gt::gt(tbl) |> gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::pct(100))
```

## Recession probability

Probit model of a recession `r horizon` months ahead on the 10Y-3M term
spread, estimated from `r format(model$train_period[1], "%Y")` to
`r format(model$train_period[2], "%Y")`. Shaded areas are recessions.

```{r recession-prob}
pp <- pred[pred$date >= start, ]
ggplot(pp, aes(target_date, probability)) +
  shade() +
  geom_line(colour = "#b2182b", linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Target date", y = NULL,
       title = sprintf("Probability of recession %d months ahead", horizon))
```

**Out-of-sample validation:** expanding-window backtest with a 6-month label
lag for NBER announcements.

```{r backtest}
m <- attr(bt, "metrics")
gt::gt(data.frame(
  Forecasts = m$n, `Base rate` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * m$base_rate),
  AUC = sprintf("%.3f", m$auc), Brier = sprintf("%.4f", m$brier),
  `In-sample AUC` = sprintf("%.3f", model$metrics$auc), check.names = FALSE
))
```

## Yield curve and policy rate

```{r curve}
long <- rbind(
  data.frame(date = plot_data$date, series = "10Y-3M spread", value = plot_data$T10Y3M),
  data.frame(date = plot_data$date, series = "Fed funds", value = plot_data$FEDFUNDS),
  data.frame(date = plot_data$date, series = "10Y yield", value = plot_data$DGS10)
)
ggplot(long, aes(date, value, colour = series)) +
  shade() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent", colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

## Labour market: Sahm rule

```{r sahm}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(date, sahm)) +
  shade() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = 2, colour = "#b2182b") +
  geom_line(colour = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "pp", title = "Sahm rule indicator (trigger at 0.5)")
```

## Regimes

```{r regime}
rg <- plot_data[!is.na(plot_data$regime), ]
ggplot(rg, aes(date, 1, fill = regime)) +
  geom_tile(height = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Reflation = "#4393c3", Recovery = "#5aae61",
                               Overheat = "#f4a582", Stagflation = "#b2182b")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Growth/inflation regime (3-month momentum of IP and CPI YoY)") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")
```

```{r regime-table}
tab <- table(d$regime)
gt::gt(data.frame(Regime = names(tab), `Share of months` =
                    sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * as.numeric(tab) / sum(tab)), check.names = FALSE))
```

```{r msm}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(date, p_contraction)) +
  shade() +
  geom_area(fill = "#b2182b", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Markov-switching probability of contraction regime (filtered, IP growth)")
```

## Output gap and financial conditions

```{r gap}
long <- rbind(
  data.frame(date = plot_data$date, series = "Output gap (IP, Hamilton filter, %)",
             value = plot_data$output_gap),
  data.frame(date = plot_data$date, series = "NFCI (positive = tight)",
             value = plot_data$NFCI)
)
ggplot(long, aes(date, value)) +
  shade() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(colour = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~series, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```
